name: render_visual
description: Render interactive visual widgets, charts, system pipelines, architecture diagrams, data tables, and KPI dashboards directly into the sovereign chat interface. Use this tool whenever presenting data visualizations, financial trading candles, portfolio donuts, server telemetry, system architectures, interactive tables, process logs, or multi-stage pipelines.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

data.description: Structured data payload matching the widget type. For trading_chart: { candles: [{ time, open, high, low, close, volume }] }. For donut_chart: { items: [{ label, value, color? }] }. For bar_chart/line_chart: { labels: [], series: [{ name, data: [], color? }] }. For radar_chart: { axes: [], series: [{ name, values: [] }] }. For kpi_deck: { cards: [{ label, value, change?, trend?: 'up'|'down', status?: 'ok'|'warn'|'err' }] }. For pipeline: { stages: [{ name, status: 'done'|'running'|'queued'|'failed' }] }. For gauge: { value, min, max, unit, label }. For data_grid: { columns: ['ColA', 'ColB'], rows: [{ ColA: 'val1', ColB: 'val2' }] }. For diagram: { nodes: [{ id: 'api', label: 'API Gateway', type: 'gateway' }], links: [{ from: 'api', to: 'auth', label: 'mTLS' }] }. For log_streamer: { logs: [{ level: 'info'|'warn'|'error', message: 'text', time?: '...' }] }.

keywords.description: Mandatory on the first tool call of a turn: Comma-separated technical domain keywords in English (e.g. 'sqlite wal concurrency' or 'canvas ui animation'). Used by Sovereign Skill Radar to search relevant skills across local storage and the official Flowork OS repository, presenting up to 3 candidates for optional pinning.

options.description: Optional visual configuration (theme, height, currency, unit, annotations).

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear, concise technical rationale explaining WHY you are calling this tool right now and what specific action it performs (displayed live to the user on every tool HUD and used on the first call to recall up to 3 memories from .fl_brain).

subtitle.description: Optional secondary subtitle or timeframe (e.g. '1H Candles - Binance', 'Disk & RAM Telemetry', 'Q3 Allocation', 'Microservices Topology').

title.description: Primary header title of the visual widget (in English).

widget_type.description: Type of visual widget: 'trading_chart' (OHLCV candles), 'donut_chart' (pie/distribution), 'bar_chart' (metrics comparison), 'line_chart' (time-series trends), 'radar_chart' (multi-axis evaluation), 'kpi_deck' (key metric cards), 'pipeline' (multi-stage progress tracker), 'gauge' (circular meter/speedometer), 'data_grid' (interactive searchable/sortable table), 'diagram' (system architecture & topology node-link map), 'log_streamer' (collapsible live terminal telemetry logs).
